Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: El profesor Elefun y el Dr. Blunt están enfrascados en una batalla por un concurso para ver quién puede aterrizar un huevo de forma segura tras soltarlo, utilizando la resistencia del viento. La competición se ve interrumpida por una llamada de auxilio del aeropuerto de Pekín, donde la jefa de control de tráfico aéreo, Maylin, intenta en vano arreglar el sistema de comunicaciones. Suzu restablece el contacto por radio con los dos últimos aviones que deben aterrizar, y el primero desciende sano y salvo con la ayuda de uno de los artilugios de Astro Kitty. Pero a medida que la tormenta de granizo se intensifica, los granizos dañan los motores del último avión, haciendo que los pilotos pierdan el control. ¡Parece que el avión se estrellará en el centro de Pekín! En una tensa misión a gran velocidad, Astro utiliza una carpa gigante como paracaídas para frenar el avión, mientras Astro Kitty lo estabiliza. Juntos, el Equipo Astro aterriza el avión de forma segura, llevando la misión a un final de infarto.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

It is an amazing week at camp with five arrows being sent down range and multiple elk hitting the dirt. You do not want to miss this one.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are back in Missouri on our new farm that we’ve recently purchased. We developed our last farm, and did a 1031 tax free exchange to buy this farm so we can develop and sell it later on. This is the first time we’ve seen the property, so we are finding out what we are going to do with it and how we are going to lay it out. Once we get that figured out, we go into the dirty work of planting, moving box stands, and making sure everything is good for hunting season. Fast forward and we have two amazing hunts where both Ryan and myself take awesome bucks with our bows. This one has it all! Do not miss it!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are super busy juggling the turkey season opener, but we also have our real estate convention in Gulf Shores Alabama, multiple listing videos to complete, and property showings. It happens every year to us, spring kicks off and people want to have properties of their own knowing dog gone well it’s the most wonderful time of the year. TURKEY SEASON! It’s a jam up of a week. You’re not going to want to miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are smacking turkeys and making mid-term investments. 1031 Tax money is the number one way to build your land portfolio and create a place for your family to enjoy. Follow along as we turn a old beat up piece of dirt and turn it into the ultimate place ground for a hunter such as myself. From habitat to harvest we have been on fire.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers

From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.desc: Willie’s challenge is to make a restaurant level Shrimp Ramen. The lovely Chef Yasmin guides him through the kitchen, Willie is mesmerized by her voice. Will the Hot Mess kitchen become the LOOOVE kitchen? Can this team beat the restaurant delivary?

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.desc: Tricia’s family includes some award winning Sushi chefs. Did she inherit any of that Sushi-rolling talent? With Chef Anthea guiding her, will Tricia, for the first time in her life, make a Sushi roll that will satisfy the judges? Or will she stay a “Hot Mess”?

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Join host Sarah Sharratt as she begins her culinary adventure in rural France. She visits a traditional festival that celebrates all things mushroom and gets put to work at her local cheesemaker. With the kids away, Sarah prepares a date night menu for her husband that includes a cream of mushroom soup, a Provence-inspired roast chicken, and mini pear and ginger cakes.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt discovers that one of the most famous ingredients of the Périgord region of France is walnuts. After a visit to a local walnut farm and nut oil press, Sarah uses these versatile nuts to make a creamy walnut ravioli, a stuffed and rolled leg of lamb, and a walnut tart inspired by her local bakery.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up his colorful Chickpea and Chard Pork, a hearty one pan wonder that’s perfect to rustle up at the end of a busy day. Next, a brilliant little recipe for egg fried rice, a fast food favorite, and a super-speedy veggie supper.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up his succulent Sticky Kickin’ Chicken Wings—super-fast finger food made for sharing—followed by his outrageously tasty Sizzling Sirloin with a time-saving trick for awesome aubergines.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Lamb has a reputation only for fine dining but it is much more accessible than that. Jenn trims hooves, makes lamb kofte, and enjoys a slow braised leg of lamb.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Chef Anna Olson bakes up three of her favourite warm desserts. These treats are perfect to serve when the air outside turns a bit chilly.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: The season finale is a showstopper! Kirsten stuns with leopard-print cupcakes, delicious chocolate lollies, and flawless macarons. She wraps up the season with another exciting 10-minute dessert challenge, leaving you inspired to bake your own masterpieces.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.sub-title: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas, Grilled Peppers, Salsa, Rice and Beans / Prawn Cocktail, King Prawns and Sun-Dried Pan Bread
programme.desc: Jamie cooks up sizzling chicken fajitas, grilled peppers, salsa, rice and beans; also, a prawn cocktail with king prawns and a sun-dried tomato pan bread.

programme.title: Feast By Fire
programme.desc: At Helberg Barbecue in Waco, Jess discovers the magic of smoke-fried chicken, where low-and-slow meets hot oil for maximum flavour and crunch. Back home, she demystifies the process, showing how to achieve that signature smoky, crispy finish without complicated equipment.

programme.title: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programme.desc: Chuck learns all about traditional lobster fishing and cooking bannock the Innu way with - Edouard Kaltush who proudly shows him how to make an artisanal harpoon.

programme.title: Wall of Bakers
programme.desc: A home baker introduces the Wall to wheel cakes in the Crowd-Pleaser round, and it's a childhood dream come true when Chef Raveena Oberoi's pantry is opened to reveal cereal and milk!

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Indulge in chocolate mastery as The Chocolate Queen dazzles once again! Kirsten showcases her steamed mousse cake, a boozy chocolate rum baba, and a classic French favourite: Paris-Brest. She also explains why biscuits spread during baking and how to perfect them every time.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals

programme.title: Wall of Chefs

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: La ira al volante se ha convertido en una patología cotidiana que afecta a miles de colombianos. Desde accidentes hasta homicidios, los desencadenantes de esta furia son múltiples, pero la empatía podrían prevenir tragedias en las vías.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Estafas de vehículos usados en Colombia afectan a numerosos compradores. Desde autos embargados hasta ventas de vehículos robados, los casos incluyen varios imputados, como Norman Eduardo Serrano y Óscar Fabián Rodríguez.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un amor pasajero entre Flaminio Báez y María del Tránsito Veloza resulta en el nacimiento de un hijo con problemas médicos y una batalla de por vida.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ana, víctima de abuso por su profesor, ve justicia tras años de denuncias. Judith, asesinada en Bogotá, revela una red criminal. Valentina, presunto suicidio, resulta ser homicidio. programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects. Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate, Alexandra. A movie theater sells artisanal concessions. The consultants from "Japanese Toys, Cool Offices" get to work.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.desc: En 1849, un enemigo fuerza a Eli a cuestionarse su lealtad. En 1915, el pasado de los McCullough vuelve para atormentarlos con resultados mortales.

programme.title: The Four Seasons (1981)
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73 ('Emperor'), featuring Beatrice Rana as the soloist. Recorded at Barbican Hall in London, UK, in 2022.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.sub-title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: La Bayadere
programme.desc: The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.sub-title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: London Has Fallen (2016)
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

Witness the intensity of collegiate rally scoring where every dink, drive, and around-the-post winner determines which team will punch their ticket to the season finale in April.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches its peak as the University of Florida and the University of Virginia face off in a high-stakes Semifinal and Final showdown. The intensity is palpable from the very first "time in," with athletes showcasing elite precision in specialized Skills challenges and explosive speed during the high-octane Racing segments. Between strategic volleys and creative Freestyle maneuvers, neither side gives an inch as the score oscillates through razor-thin margins, trading momentum with every "right back" play. This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mata a tu padre con cuchillo; Contrato para sentirse famoso
programme.desc: Simón exige establecer la paternidad de la hija que tiene con Catalina, así como la custodia total. Mario pide una orden de alejamiento para Guadalupe, ella insiste en que él es un estafador.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Por honor a mi patria; Sobrina acosada
programme.desc: José, veterano del ejército, le pide a su padre que no se divorcie y que cuide a su madre mientras él esté ausente. Karla quiere alejarse de su tía, dice que ella es peor que Maduro y Chávez juntos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El baile de la gorda; Mi suegro es un ladrón
programme.desc: Jorge demanda a Silvia, la acusa de usar a su hermana con problemas mentales y de sobrepeso como bailarina erótica. Natacha le exige a su suegro, Rafael, que le devuelva el dinero que le robó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No american flag; Caña o ballet
programme.desc: Una escuela prohíbe el uso de prendas de vestir con la bandera, pero Jack viola la regla y lo despiden. Su madre descubre que es gay y lo echa de la casa, ahora regresa para cumplir su sueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Curar a mi hija con cuy; Falsas acusaciones
programme.desc: Lucía exige que Jorge firme el permiso para someter a su hija a un tratamiento experimental, pero él cree que es brujería. La vida de un maestro se destruye por la acusación de una de sus alumnas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Crossfit sex; El caso de Nerson
programme.desc: Por culpa del CrossFit quiere solo sexo violento, su esposo ya no aguanta, pide ayuda psicológica para ella o el divorcio. Rosa exige que Jinnette adopte a su hermana menor, no quiere criarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El difunto no está muerto; ¿A quién pertenece la niña?
programme.desc: Lorena queda viuda y se casa con Daniel, pero el difunto regresa y ella quiere que viva en la casa. Cambian a dos niñas por error, una muere y la otra sobrevive, las dos familias la reclaman.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sombrero para el miembro; Cerebro frito
programme.desc: Inventa fábrica de sombreros que adornan los miembros sexuales masculinos cuando están erectos y lo demandan. Erick quiere demostrar que los teléfonos celulares destruyen el cerebro humano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La última nalgada; Evidencia en teléfono
programme.desc: Alicia exige que su marido deje su práctica de masajes con nalgadas o se divorcia. Jessica demanda a su amiga Karla, porque le entregó a la policía un teléfono celular que la llevó a la cárcel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Padre sale de prisión; Éxtasis mortal
programme.desc: Después de años preso, este padre sale de la cárcel y exige la custodia de su hija. Lola quiere emanciparse, su padrastro practica la autoestrangulación en el sexo y así murió su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pasteles grotescos; Chica malcriada exige manutención
programme.desc: Francisco es repostero y prepara impactantes pasteles con imágenes eróticas y sexuales. A Mariana la echan de su casa por malcriada, ella demanda a sus padres, exige que ellos la mantengan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El ojo del amor; Enemas de cloro para autistas
programme.desc: Boris es tuerto y su único ojo es para Ana, ella lo amaba, pero él se volvió violento. Raúl pide la custodia de su hija con Isabel, quien quiere curar el autismo de la niña con enemas de cloro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Elizabeth exige un cambio en la póliza de su complejo residencial que respete el nudismo-cristianismo. Blanca pide una orden de desalojo y una de alejamiento para Pablo, pero él no piensa marcharse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo adoptivo padre de mi hijo; M. Broun abuso policíaco
programme.desc: Maritza adopta a Santiago, cuando crece se enamora de él y sale embarazada. Williams quiere impedir que su esposa mexicana entre a la academia de policía. El momento es muy conflictivo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hombre como objeto sexual; Santo cachón con un negro
programme.desc: Bárbara demanda a Estefany, porque se llevó de la casa el juguete sexual que compartían. Sebastián pide el divorcio, cree que su esposa lo engañó, tuvo gemelas, una es negra y la otra blanca.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Babalawo mexicano; Preso, viudo y casi papá
programme.desc: Hugo quiere las cenizas de su bebé para llevarlas a Cuba, es Babalawo y necesita recuperar su energía. David debe ir a la cárcel, pero antes, quiere darle a su cuñada la custodia de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Trío pide examen de paternidad; Parto naturista
programme.desc: Dos hombres y una mujer tienen una relación y ella se embaraza, quieren saber quién tiene derechos sobre el bebé. Flor desea dar a luz de manera natural en el Amazonas, su esposo está aterrado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La hockey y el acróbata; Colegio expulsa actor porno
programme.desc: Roberto exige que Carolina cumpla el contrato que firmaron, ella quiere anularlo porque él está obsesionado. Expulsan a Manolo de la escuela por hacer una película porno, su madre lo defiende.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Tapón de bañadera con dólares; Me excita mi hermano porno
programme.desc: Loraine es una niña de 15 años y tiene un novio de 40; quiere emanciparse de su madre. Diego pide ayuda psicológica para su esposa; ella solo tiene sexo si ve las películas porno de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amarrada en daycare; Desafío del hielo
programme.desc: Una madre descubre que en el jardín de infantes amarran a su hija de cuatro años, por lo que demanda a la dueña. Laura denuncia que la despidieron por negarse a participar en el desafío de las cubetas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Carlitos bacteria; La dejé de amar por loca
programme.desc: Carlitos le teme tanto a los gérmenes y bacterias que no hace el amor con su esposa, ella intenta una locura. Bruno exige una orden de alejamiento para su exmujer, ella lo persigue y lo acosa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María exige que su marido reciba ayuda psicológica, está obsesionado con las caricaturas pornográficas. Mónica acusa a su novio de darle pastillas abortivas, pero él asegura que ella miente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vendida antes de nacer; El próximo asesino en serie
programme.desc: A Julieta la contratan como madre subrogada y tras dar a luz, ella se niega a entregar al niño. Vivian le exige a su esposo que corra de la casa a su hijastro, lo considera un asesino.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La rumana, meditación orgásmica; Niño no sabe de padres separados
programme.desc: Alexandra quiere un sexo más placentero, por eso pide que su esposo aprenda meditación orgásmica. Yesica exige el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo; aunque están separados, aún vive con Noel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mamá abusadora fuera; Me niego amor por premonición
programme.desc: Cuando era pequeña, su madre la vendió como esclava sexual. Ahora solo quiere vengarse. Rodrigo, novio de Celeste, tuvo una relación con la gemela de su pareja. Ella muere y él quiere terminar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Propuesta cibernética del nerd; Con cáncer terminal y un ...
programme.desc: Paola pide el divorcio, su joven marido es un nerd que pasa todo el día conectado a la computadora. Juan tiene solo 16 años y padece de un cáncer terminal, solo quiere cumplir con un sueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Marido de papá hereda; Madre humilla hijos en FB
programme.desc: Angelina pide invalidar el testamento de su padre, quien le dejó todos sus bienes a su pareja gay. Una madre castiga a sus hijos y comparte las imágenes en internet; ellos se sienten humillados.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quinceañera pompis y chichis; Hija de 17 casada con haitiano
programme.desc: Mariana quiere la custodia de su hermana menor porque su madre insiste en regalarle una cirugía plástica. Es una niña y se casa sin permiso con un negro haitiano porque su madre es racista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amante embarazada y loca; Agente inmobiliario se adueñó de casa
programme.desc: Jack tiene un romance con Angélica y la embaraza. Ahora la difama para quedarse con el bebé. Sofía comete el error de tener sexo en una de las casas que ella vende; el dueño lo graba todo.

programme.desc: Milagros consigue trabajo en las empresas Talamonti, pero se da cuenta de que está enamorada de Enzo y sufre al saber que él tiene una novia con la cual se va a casar. programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que Cristóbal se enterara la verdad acerca de que su Ana era la misma Ana de la historia de amor de Guillermo, rompe su relación con ella, por lo que Marilda y Guillermo encuentran la oportunidad de volver con sus respectivos amores. Pero Onofre le aconseja a Cristóbal que no se separe, y vuelve al ruedo cuando le perdona a Ana la mentira, y le pide nuevamente que se case con él. Mientras que Venancio continúa en la búsqueda del asesino por el envenenado del acotamiento, otra muerte sucumbe al condominio: Diego, el vecino del cuarto piso, apareció sin vida en su apartamento por presunta muerte natural.

programme.title: Episodio 114 (2026)
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri tienen su día de amor. Juan Diego está en la casa de Bienvenida buscando a Yubiri. Bienvenida se preocupa porque ella pensaba que estaba en la agencia. Pero entonces todos piensan que está con Solymar pero esta llega en ese preciso momento buscándola. Fabián | Junior | Olegario y Pastor están jugando dominó. Fabián vuelve con lo de Finita y de repente todos se le quedan viendo porque tiene dos tremendos cachos. Finita le cuenta a Ana lo de Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. Ricardo acuerda con Julieta que publicará en “La Deslenguada” que lo de Magdalena y Gabriel fueron rumores infundados pero con una condición, que vaya a la casa con Jamer y le averigüe todo sobre Magdalena Miranda.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: The Exorcist III (1990)
programme.desc: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

programme.title: Sliding Doors (1998)
programme.desc: After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.

programme.title: Point Break (1991)
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

programme.title: Funny Games (1997)
programme.desc: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

programme.title: Judgment Night (1993)
programme.desc: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man (1992)
programme.desc: A scientist uses an intellectually disabled gardener as a guinea pig in his experiments with intelligence enhancing drugs and virtual reality. The man transforms into a genius, but not without side effects.

programme.title: Timecop (1994)
programme.desc: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

programme.title: Legionnaire (1998)
programme.desc: A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.

programme.title: Basquiat (1996)
programme.desc: Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.

programme.title: Body Bags (1993)
programme.desc: Filmmaker John Carpenter introduces a trio of terror tales: "Unleaded," "Hair" and Tobe Hooper's "Baseball Man."

programme.title: The Road to Wellville (1994)
programme.desc: Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.

programme.title: Prehysteria! 3 (1995)
programme.desc: Pygmy dinosaurs help the owner (Fred Willard) of a miniature golf course fight off bank foreclosure and takeover by his greedy brother (Bruce Weitz).

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael (1990)
programme.desc: An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.

programme.title: The .44 Specialist (2026)
programme.desc: An undercover cop goes deep inside a dangerous terrorist network to expose high-level corruption.

programme.title: Last Feelings (2024)
programme.desc: Diego is a boy with problems. Tartassed at school, he does not find a better climate in his family, harassed as he is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sports club where he can secretly train in swimming, his great sporting passion. There he also finds a couple of loving friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a son. However, fate has a bitter sentence in store.

programme.title: Rattler Kid (2026)
programme.desc: Falsely accused of treason, a former army officer escapes prison to hunt down the real culprits.

programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure (2024)
programme.desc: Alan, a gambler, drains his uncle's savings and takes refuge on Charlie's boat, on a cruise. They shipwreck on an island, defend a tribe from pirates and discover a Japanese fort with treasure. In the end, the money turns out to be fake and Alan forgets a diamond idol, later exhibited in a museum where they are both hired as labourers.

programme.title: La moglie in vacanza l'amante in città (2025)
programme.desc: A comedic drama about a man who navigates a love triangle while his wife is away on vacation.

programme.title: Love hurts (2024)
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: Wild Boys (2026)
programme.desc: Five delinquent youths escape a reformatory and embark on a violent, lawless spree across the country.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922 (2025)
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928 (2025)
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933 (2025)
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934 (2025)
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938 (2025)
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940 (2025)
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: Auschwitz One Day (2025)
programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis (2025)
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis (2025)
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs (2025)
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation (2025)
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War (2025)
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is My Teen Blinded By Love?
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Teen Girl Obsessed With Her Ex
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil

So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.
