programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals the health secrets behind your bodily fluids. Find out how to keep acne breakouts at bay and how to stop excessive perspiration!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors present five-minute cures for common ailments. See a procedure that stops nasal allergy symptoms for good. And, cosmetic dentist Dr. Dorfman shares dental Dos and Don'ts, including an instant cure for canker sores.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Fix It or Live With It?
programme.desc: Embarrassing conditions, annoying problem areas, unsightly body parts … everyone has at least one or two. But you don’t have to be stuck with them! Get solutions for painful heartburn, frequent urination, stuttering and more.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, a young man falls 2,000+ feet and survives days in a blizzard…how did he do it? Are you paying different prices for the exact same medication? Why are more and more women turning to physical therapy for their private parts? Could loneliness be as deadly as cigarettes? Then, a husband and wife turn back the clock with facelifts … and reveal their new looks on set! We test magnetic eyelashes and tell you if they work! Plus, see what happens when bullfighting goes wrong … very wrong!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: We go “inside the O.R.” for an amazing update as two identical twin sisters get the “twinning” facelifts they’ve always wanted! The RefrigerDATEr’s back to help another single bachelorette find a man – by looking through the contents of his refrigerator! Is viral “60 second rule” to a clearer face legit? Is the mental workload of running a house harming moms’ health?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Exclusive: A woman famous for her 70-inch booty visits The Doctors! Is she in for a shocking diagnosis? Then, are you upping your family’s fire risk without even knowing it? We reveal three dangerous household items! Plus, a woman desperate to walk again turns to The Doctors for help!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Top 5 Questions To Ask Your Doctor
programme.desc: Learn how to interview potential doctors, which tests you need and how to make the most of your next doctor’s visit. Plus, when you need to go to the emergency room – STAT.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Teen Mom OG stars Catelynn and Tyler Baltierra open up about Catelynn’s treatment for postpartum depression and the recent tabloid divorce rumors! Plus, he went from bullied to buff, and now one of your favorite guests returns to show off his skin removal! See the surgery closer than ever… from a Go-Pro camera on the surgeon’s head! And, one teen’s amazing transformation after a surgery to straighten the 180-degree angle in his head and neck!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Tis The Season to Be Healthy
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: The holidays are here! Get the secrets to staying healthy and trim while celebrating the season. Get delicious recipes, surefire workouts, and fabulous gift ideas for the loved ones on your list!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Bikini Wax Almost Killed Me
programme.desc: Burns, bleeding and infections are just a few of the dangers associated with waxing. But what about death? Meet a woman who almost lost her life after a bikini wax. And, learn secret beauty tips from a celebrity makeup artist!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors discusses the wackiest health headlines! Hilarious photos of toddlers in a fake tan mess and how to safely clean up a bad tan! Which state has the most psychopaths? The best beauty buys all for under $10! The Doctors diagnoses your toilet dilemmas in a segment called, “What The Flush!” Instant treatment to reverse tremors?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors checks in with a Season 10 guest who dropped over 300 pounds naturally after he received one of the most graphic skin removal surgeries ever! How is he doing today and what weight-loss advice does he have? “Good & Cheap” author teaches us how to eat healthy for four dollars a day! Controversial study claims women should have shorter workweeks than men? What do our hosts think? Smartphone notifications aren’t just annoying – They might be messing up your brain permanently!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Staying healthy can sometimes feel like a challenge too large to overcome. Talk-show host Montel Williams joins THE DOCTORS to help you take charge of your health! Previously on THE DOCTORS, Montel helped motivate Alex, who suffers from dystonia. See how she is doing now and learn about a procedure that may help Alex overcome the disorder! Do your family dinners lack the proper nutrition? Montel makes a house call and provides one family with an action plan for healthier eating. The outbreak of the swine flu caused a nationwide scare. Now, the vaccine for the strain of flu is cause for concern. Former acting U.S. Surgeon General, Steven J, Galson, answers your H1N1 vaccine questions.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Love is in the air. Discover new tricks to look your best this Valentine’s Day. And, America’s favorite “sexpert,” Dr. Ruth Westheimer, reveals surprising ways to send your sex drive into overdrive.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, see how a team of Doctors repaired one baby’s heart, in utero! The groundbreaking technique that allows surgeons to fix fetal heart defects inside the womb! Plus, actress and comedian Jenifer Lewis opens up her bipolar disorder and the unlikely cure that has helped her find peace! Then, American Idol alum Bucky Covington shares a heartwarming update on his daughter’s health. The simple tips that can calm you during a panic attack! And, the sweet treat that can really slash your stroke risk.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Insta-famous fitness star Abby Pollock is known for her “peach booty” that’s so perfect some say it’s fake! A live glute ultrasound reveals the truth, while Abby shares a shocking admission about her past. When a bad habit becomes debilitating, a woman turns to The Doctors for help! Special correspondent Rosie Mercado joins The Doctors and is shocked to hear that people are putting apple cider vinegar… down where? Is there any truth to the internet rumor urging women to try DIY “tightening”? Could a contraceptive gel for men change birth control forever? Should you stay friends with your ex? Hear what The Doctors has to say! Then, Dr. Travis tears up as he talks about his beloved dog, Nala, and her health struggles. A 97-year-old record-breaking sprinter … how does he do it? And, the easiest way to peel garlic, ever!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In an emergency, the split-second decisions we make can mean the difference between life and death. CNN’s chief medical correspondent, Dr. Sanjay Gupta, joins The Doctors to reveal what you need to know about life-saving medicine.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Common Medical Risks On The Go
programme.desc: Behind the wheel, in a plane or on a train, learn how to avoid injuries and stay safe while on the go. And, Dr. Travis’ fun and safe workout tips for busy moms.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: “Ask The Doctors” episode. Woman who can’t stop urinating herself! Could you enhance your “manhood” with stem cells? Sleep doctor helps woman who shouts in her sleep! Why do you wake up every night … at the same time? We know why! Hollywood’s hottest plastic surgeons discuss the latest cosmetic trends! Dr. Nita Landry answers all your gyno questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS tests an app that promises to measure just how ugly you are and the results aren’t pretty! Find out why a hospital billed a couple for holding their newborn! In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, Olivia Newton-John’s daughter, Chloe Lattanzi, reveals the truth behind the plastic surgery rumors! Then, baseball legend Darryl Strawberry discusses his battle with addiction and his attempt to reach out to NBA star Lamar Odom! Plus, the hidden dangers of Halloween make-up

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: All summer long, teams of plastic surgeons, cosmetic dentists and dozens of stylists worked around the clock. Now, The Doctors presents a makeover show so big, a call had to be made to The Guinness Book of World Records!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: See a cure for chronic ear infections, a laser treatment that eliminates back pain and technology that guarantees less time in the dentist’s chair. And, at-home remedies that can cure a cold, calm a flu and quell motion sickness.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors checkup, we go inside the O.R. as a guest who lost 280 pounds gets skin removal surgery! Meet the biggest weight-loss loser of the #DropTheSugar Challenge! Dr. Travis’ skills are put to the test in the Baby Daddy Challenge! Could weekend brunch be causing us to put on weight.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Hot and Cold Edition
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals the best hot and cold remedies for ailments. And, surprising ways the weather can sabotage your health. From winter storm warnings to heat waves, learn how to keep your family safe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Have you ever been stuck on a frustrating medical merry-go-round, receiving wrong diagnosis after wrong diagnosis? The Doctors teach you how to avoid misinformation and how to get the best treatment right now!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors counts down the top five health scares. Learn when a headache can lead to a deadly stroke. And, 15 percent of pregnancies end in miscarriage. Dr. Lisa shares ways to prevent the heartbreaking loss.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From lips and legs to labor and libido, The Doctors explores the “L” words everyone loves or loathes and gives you the tools to start feeling and looking your absolute best! And find out the best ways to fight lethargy.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors blow the lid off America’s silent killer: salt. Learn how to take action and join the nationwide movement to Halt The Salt! And, NBA champ Magic Johnson explains the biggest fight of his life.

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.desc: Tone, tighten and sculpt your booty with celebrity trainer David Kirsch’s signature exercises! And, how to get rid of adult acne, eliminate crow’s feet and look a size smaller in less than 60 seconds!

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: When they arrive at the house in El Jagüey, Mother Isabel does not let them enter, they meet Henry and presume that he may also be Rosa Blanco's son. Max thinks that something serious

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel insists that Rosa Blanco will cause much harm to Camila. Little is known, only that through a phone call she assures that she will return to take revenge.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel, rejected by Camila, manipulates her with a new job offer as assistant to his daughter Julia, all to try to get her closer to him. Max trusts in Camila's love. Torrealba asks them to join forces to find Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insists on knowing about her family relationship, she thinks she could be Max's cousin. Ezequiel wants to dispel the doubt that she could be his niece, he interrogates Mother Isabel who denies knowing it and also turns to Marcelina who confirms it. Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: Red River (1948)
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio (1956)
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Gun The Man Down (1956)
programme.desc: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town (1958)
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Man With The Gun (1955)
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country (1959)
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young (1969)
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey (2023)
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Scalphunters (1968)
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming (1971)
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Lawman (1971)
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson (2023)
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches (2026)
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Ned Kelly (1970)
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han despertado el interés de Kim Olegovich, mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos, decidido a separarlos. Atraído por Sasha, Kim recurre al chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella, y la relación de la pareja empieza a desmoronarse. Justo cuando está a punto de lograr su objetivo, le llega una noticia que lo sacude a él... y a toda la Casa de Modelos: Sasha se va a casar.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Lika está a punto de resolver el caso de un psicópata que aterroriza Moscú desde hace seis meses, matando una vez al mes y dejando pistas sobre el paradero de cada víctima. Tras analizar los datos, deduce que la próxima estará en la azotea de un rascacielos inacabado. Ya de noche, llega hasta allí y, justo cuando está a punto de admitir su error, recibe un golpe en la cabeza. Lo último que ve antes de desmayarse es un tablero electrónico gigante marcando las 23:59:59…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras verifica su teoría sobre el posible lugar del próximo asesinato, Besedina llega a un rascacielos abandonado

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Tres meses después, Lika despierta en un hospital. Debido a una lesión, su cerebro borra diariamente toda la información adquirida durante el día. Cada jornada, Lika intenta completar el mismo camino: recordar quién es, volver a recopilar todos los datos sobre la serie de asesinatos y lograr identificar al criminal antes de la medianoche.

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Cada día, Lika está más cerca de resolver el misterio, pero la noche borra de su memoria todo lo que ha descubierto. Un día, finalmente se da cuenta de quién es el asesino, pero con horror comprende que al amanecer lo habrá olvidado…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Lika está a punto de resolver el caso de un psicópata que aterroriza Moscú desde hace seis meses, matando una vez al mes y dejando pistas sobre el paradero de cada víctima. Tras analizar los datos, deduce que la próxima estará en la azotea de un rascacielos inacabado. Ya de noche, llega hasta allí y, justo cuando está a punto de admitir su error, recibe un golpe en la cabeza. Lo último que ve antes de desmayarse es un tablero electrónico gigante marcando las 23:59:59…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras verifica su teoría sobre el posible lugar del próximo asesinato, Besedina llega a un rascacielos abandonado
